svg.text: Record layouts I — building blocks and shapes (§4, §5)
Each strip is the data of one object after its class tag (§3.2), field by field in stored order; the number above a cell is its offset from the start of that data,
shown while every field before it has a fixed size. Sizes are in bytes; "2+" is a 2-byte tag, followed by the object itself where it is first written.
frames; no tag of its own
a pin of a gate drawing
A dashed cell is present only under a condition. A cell named by its type alone is an embedded part, drawn as a strip of its own where it is described.
